notes.title: Update v0.520: Crouch and Weapon Hand IK
notes.content:
Horde Together update v0.520 has been released.

This patch is the first of several small patches to prepare for a ton of new weapons and the next two characters being added to the game. The focus right now is to polish several aspects of the character/weapon animations to make adding new content in the future.

- Character crouching has been added to the game, this will later be incorporated into a stealth mechanic.

- Character hand IK has been added to the character animation system. This allows for custom hand placement on the weapons, allowing for a more realistic looking game and allowing for more types of weapons to be added to the game.

Please be aware the new IK system has made a few of the animations buggy such as reloads. This will be the main focus of the next few small updates.

notes.title: Update v0.420: Melee Combat System
notes.content:
Horde Together update v0.420 has been released. 

-Melee system has been added to the game. Each character has a unique melee weapon, and each character has a different amount of Melee damaged based on the attribute system.

notes.title: Update v0.410: Keybinds and Music Updates
notes.content:
Horde Together update v0.410 has been released. Thank you to everybody who wishlisted during Steam Nextfest, your support is appreciated. This is small patch but I wanted to use this time to announce some upcoming features in work.

[b]General Updates[/b]

-Fully functioning keybind system has been implemented

-Music player system has been implemented, so far it only has music on the main menu and lobby, but allows easy implementation into the main game later on.

[b]Features in Work[/b]

-Melee System, each character will have a unique melee weapon that do varying degrees of damage

-More Guns, Grenade Launcher, and Hand Grenades

-More characters

-VOIP

-I have a 2nd map in work, I will offer some sneak peaks of it soon

-Localization, I am working on implementing all the systems required to translate the game into more languages. Please be patient with this, but I will be sure to have all languages ready to go by launch


Give this post a like if I should create a discord server to start building a community for Horde Together!

notes.title: Update v0.400: Steam Next Fest Content Update
notes.content:
Horde Together update v0.400 has been released. I am excited to announce our largest update to date, with loads of new content and rewords leading into Steam Next Fest. 


[b]General Updates[/b]

Multiplayer increased from 4 players to 5 players

Lobby map completely reworked

Freelook added while in game

Jump height reworked, can no longer jump over / on top of zombies

Attribute bars on character selection screen are now animated when selecting another character

Max zombies that can alive at any given time has been reduced from 40 to 30 to save on bandwidth during multiplayer

Added multiple hit particle systems based on what material was shot

[b]Character Updates[/b]

“Mr Greedwell” character added to game
“Darnell” character added to game
“Ms Maisy” character added to game

Sergei’s character model changed to remove head covering

All characters now have to two abilities to add alongside there attributes

All character health amount reworked

Character down animations reworked

[b]Weapon Updates[/b]

G18 renamed to Striker 9
M93A1 renamed to Jackal 45
Pit Viper renamed to Wrangler .357
Mac10 renamed to Vulture
KG-99 renamed to Rebel
KP5 renamed to Phantom 505
SMG45 renamed to Vortex 45

PKM renamed to PPK-71 Varyag

Vintorez renamed to TKN-90 Dragun
SASR 12.7 renamed to Reaper 12.7

All weapon aim spread reworked
All weapon ADS zoom settings reworked

Stowed Wrangler .357 scaling error fixed
Stowed TAC12 position error fixed

Vulture Fire Rate Adjusted
Rebel Fire Rate Adjusted

“Vector” removed from game due to animation issues
“Kar98” removed from game due to animation issues
“Dragonov” removed from game due to animation issues

[b]UI Updates[/b]

Crosshairs reworked

Hitmarkers added to game

Reworked player score colors, added colors to support up to six players

Reworked equipment HUD elements, equipment will now display underneath ammo count and will display which equipment you current have and don't have

Health damage bloody screen reworked

[b]Character Updates[/b]

Multiple new enemies added to the game, the spawn system was completely reworked in order to spawn more challenging enemies the later you get into the game.

Magazine / Total Ammo HUD element reworked. Total ammo remaining will turn red once you have 50 or less bullets remaining.
Lobby UI elements reworked and updated

[b]SFX Updates[/b]

Hitmarker SFX added

Headshot UI SFX added

“Big Hit” UI SFX added

SFX added for when player takes hit from zombie

Bullet hit SFX changes based on material

Heartbeat SFX plays once under 50 health

[b]Bug Fixes[/b]

Wall Weapon and Random Weapon Box not giving correct ammo count based on character attributes fixed

Errors fixed that allowed shooting while in freelook

Error fixed so you are no longer able to shoot while reviving, will have animations in place in a following update

Networking error fixed that only allowed zombie knockback in singleplayer mode

notes.title: Update v0.210: Massive Map Rework and Backpacks
notes.content:
Horde Together update v0.210 has been released. This will be our last major update of 2024. Thanks to everyone who has tried the game so far! In the coming months expect more content on each update and hopefully less reworks and bug fixes.

==

Dudley Village map zones 3 and 4 completely reworked. Beware of possible bugs and errors in the new zones.

Dudley Village Shack #1 interior completed and purchase point for “Fortunate Son” added

Backpack added to the game. Purchasing a backpack allows for a 3rd weapon slot on your character. 

Purchase SFX added for weapon purchase, door purchase, and item purchase

Main Menu background image updated

Kar98 damage increased by 50%

Dragunov damage increased by 70%

SASR 12.7 damage increased by 50%

Dragunov firing sound updated

SASR 12.7 firing sound updated

Pause menu font size updated

Lobby menu font size updated


Happy New Years to everybody!

notes.title: Demo Update v0.205: Character Attribute System
notes.content:
Horde Together Demo update v0.205 has been released.

==

All playable characters now have four assigned attributes. Health, Speed, Stamina, and Ammo Capacity. These attributes are unique to each character and makes your character selection matter.

Level items textures reduced in order to reduce game download size

Zombie damage now increases each round

notes.content:

Zombies will now fall backwards when killed. High damage weapons such as snipers or shotguns will cause zombies to fly backwards

Zombie heads and arms will now break off when damaged, legs coming soon

Plate Carriers added to games, gives you 2.5x health when purchased

Dudley Village playground area reworked. Please note the entire Dudley Village map will be going under a massive rework over the next few updates.
